title: Sony Stops Selling Its Final UHD Blu-ray Player in Japan
excerpt: Sony has ended sales of its last standalone Ultra HD Blu-ray player model, the UBP-X700/K, in the Japanese market.
body_html: Sony has discontinued the UBP-X700/K, which was its last remaining standalone Ultra HD Blu-ray player model available in Japan. The quiet end of sales for this device points to a potential withdrawal from the standalone disc player market by the company.
